name: VOMO
tagline: Find and read your VOMO meeting notes and transcripts
description: Connect your existing VOMO account to list and search saved meeting notes and read their summaries or original transcripts. Uses the hosted VOMO MCP server with OAuth sign-in and the notes:read scope. Read-only: no recording, uploads, note editing, deletion, or purchases.

install.notes: Sign in to an existing VOMO account and authorize read-only access. Saved VOMO notes are required. Documentation: https://vomo.ai/cli
